get.summary: Public MEME list for the MEME web page
get.description: Decision 0147. No authentication, no contract headers; CORS `*`, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=15`, per-IP rate limit. Activated launch2 instances, newest first. stage: all (default) | graduated | curve (not graduated); limit 1–50 (default 50). dynamic: the LoopDynamic Hook's armed() and current dynamic sell tax (bps) for a graduated LoopDynamic instance, null otherwise. A row whose Hook read is unavailable keeps dynamic null and names the 503 reason in dynamicReasonCode (the detail of that instance answers the 503).

dynamicReasonCode.description: Set (with dynamic null) when this graduated LoopDynamic row's Hook read is unavailable — the reason the detail answers with its 503. Null otherwise.

503.description: CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with the launch2 reason as is (PUBLIC_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT when the read exceeds its time budget, LAUNCH2_REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE, LAUNCH2_CHAIN_READ_FAILED, LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_ROUTER_NOT_CONFIGURED, LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_ROUTER_CODE_MISMATCH, LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_FACTORY_UNKNOWN, LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_ROUTER_MISMATCH, LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_HOOK_NOT_INDEXED, LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_HOOK_MISMATCH, LAUNCH2_DYNAMIC_HOOK_NOT_INITIALIZED, V2_LAUNCH2_MODULE_DEFERRED, …); never a partial body.

get.description: Decision 0147. instance (identity, contracts, explorer, socials from the creator's saved links), the bound community's public profile (null when none), the indexed last price with its 24 h change, dynamic (graduated LoopDynamic only: the Hook read at one block — armed, current round, current dynamic tax, pending pot = carry + the round's dynamic fees, last closed round; null for OfficialTax or before graduation), totals (curve 10 % tax, pool base buy fee in MEME / base sell fee in USD1, dynamic fees, USD1 equivalent at the last price, rewards allocated / claimed, buyback ledger). Hook read failures answer 503 with the launch2 reason as is.

perAddressCurveCapMeme.description: Decision 0152 (loop-contracts Decision 0015): the curve's per-address lifetime purchase cap in MEME, read from the chain — maxCumulativeBuy() (S209, a Factory parameter) or MAX_CUMULATIVE_BUY() (5,000,000 before); the verified value when the chain is unreachable.

listing.description: Decision 0163: `hidden` = taken off the public list (GET /public/v1/meme) by an operator; this detail still reads it.

slogan.description: First non-empty line of the community description, ≤ 60 code points (communities keep no separate tagline).

avatarUrl.description: Always null: community logos are App presets or authenticated media.

armed.description: The Hook's armed(): a reward round is active (悬挂状态开启).

openPriceUsd1.description: Open price of the current 5-minute candle: the round closes at the first candle that closes at or above its open (Decision 0144).

currentDynamicTaxBps.description: Dynamic sell tax at the current price: min(drop, cap) in bps; 0 = base 2 % only.

baseBuyFeeBps.description: Base buy fee in bps. Decision 0152: with buyFeeToken usd1 (S209 Hook) it is taken from the USD1 input — fee = floor(amountIn × bps / 10,000), the pool swaps the rest, the MEME output is untaxed; with meme (pre-S209 Hook) from the MEME output.

buyFeeToken.description: Decision 0152 (loop-contracts Decision 0015): the token the base buy fee is charged in — usd1 for an S209 Hook (address bits 0x10CC), meme before (0x10C4).

pendingPotUsd1.description: carry + the armed round's dynamic fees (= dynamic-pool potUsd1). At close half goes to the round's buyers, half is carried.

poolBaseBuyFeeMeme.description: Σ official-pool buy fees charged in MEME: OfficialTax and pre-S209 LoopDynamic Hooks.

poolBaseBuyFeeUsd1.description: Decision 0152: Σ LoopDynamic buy fees charged in USD1 (S209 Hooks, from the input); 0 otherwise.

totalTaxUsd1Equivalent.description: curveTaxUsd1 + poolBaseSellFeeUsd1 + poolBaseBuyFeeUsd1 + dynamicFeesUsd1 + poolBaseBuyFeeMeme × lastPriceUsd1 (floored); null when there is MEME tax but no price.

get.description: Decision 0147. interval: 5m only (any other value 400 PUBLIC_CANDLE_INTERVAL_UNSUPPORTED); limit 1–300 (default 300), newest buckets, oldest first. Graduated: source pool — a LoopDynamic Hook's own CandleClosed candles (open / close, high / low widened to the bucket's swaps, volume = swap USD1), else the indexed pool swaps; not graduated: source curve — curve trades priced at the curve's marginal price after each trade, volume = USD1 gross. Prices are USD1 per MEME.
